name: znetwork_apply_status_fields_to_session_desc
description: zNetwork::ApplyStatusFieldsToSessionDesc writes custom status fields and session name into the current DirectPlay session descriptor and commits it with SetSessionDesc.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Binary Ninja still renders the string-copy loops through low-level temporary expressions, but source and smoke coverage match the descriptor contract.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48bb20 validates writing custom event/status/value/aux fields, maxPlayers, session-name text, calling DirectPlay SetSessionDesc, returning 0 on HRESULT failure, and mirroring the committed session name into the cache on success.
The native zNetwork session-status smoke verifies successful descriptor application, SetSessionDesc call count, session-name cache update, and failure return on provider error.
